# Shared design token catalog

English | [中文](design-token-catalog.zh.md)

<!-- Generated by `pnpm run generate-design-token-catalog`; do not edit the token list by hand. -->

The Client theme source currently defines **445 shared tokens**. This index records every globally owned `--dsw-*` token by its authoritative stylesheet. Exact values and light/dark mappings remain defined only in those CSS sheets; component CSS must consume the semantic role and must not copy its value.

Primitive palette and scale names are inputs to semantic tokens. Components should prefer `--dsw-alias-*` and use `--dsw-specific-*` only for a real component contract. `--dsw-static-*` is for the theme owner, not feature styles.
